in_sanskrit.name: Ambalal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the World
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ambalal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ambalal is derived from the Sanskrit language, where 'Amba' means 'Lord' and 'Lal' means 'World'. This name signifies the one who is the ruler of the universe.

in_hindi.name: अम्बलाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who embodies the qualities of Goddess Parvati and brings joy
